title: Let Me Help You Release Some Tension (ORIGINAL)
description: Hey there… sorry to have kept you waiting. Come with me down the hall, alright? I’ve made the room nice and cozy for us. The lights are dimmed, candles are flickering softly, and there’s a chill mix playing in the background. The scented oils are warm and ready. Now strip naked and lie down on the table, I'll look away of course. That's it.... arms resting comfortably at your sides. You'll feel me working through the knots easing away the tension in your body....along with the clutter on your mind...getting blanker, emptier. And as time passes you'll feel the nice warm waves spreading through you, maybe even pleasurable sensations building up—Let it wash over you. Don't fight it, submit to it Every now and then, I’ll gently tell you to clench… and release. Just follow my voice. Trust the rhythm. And when we are done I'll give you some quiet space to rest and recover, a quiet moment before you rejoins the world.
author: Mistress Shibby
